title: Carpenter Shorts - Light Wash
sourceText: Our iconic Carpenter Jeans turned into shorts. We took this classic workwear style and made it our own with contrast stitching and broken twill denim. title: Japanese Gothic & Lolita Street Fashion w/ Edera+Peta-Peta Fish Headdress, Atelier Boz Matilda Dress, Chante Bird Cage Skirt, Triple Fortune & Metamorphose Temps De Fille Platforms
sourceText: Meet Sana Seine, a Japanese gothic lolita who is a well known personality in the Tokyo subculture fashion scene. We were lucky to meet Sana on the street in Harajuku. Sana styled her ombre gray and pink hair up into curly twin tails, which she accented with an Edera+peta-peta lolita lace headdress featuring a fish head and floral accents. She wore an Atelier Boz Matilda gothic and lolita one piece dress coat – a steampunk-inspired swing coat which features a jabot collar, a zippered front with vintage button accents, shoulder and side straps, and a tiered black dress panel at the back. She styled her coat dress with a black faux leather bird cage skirt from Chante, donned black Triple Fortune fishnets with embroidered details and stud accents and finished off her style with black platform doll shoes from Metamorphose Temps De Fille. Sana embellished her Japanese gothic lolita look with blue flower boutonnieres, a layered filigree cross charm necklace, and a bronze flower pendant necklace with matching rings. In addition, Sana is carrying a colorblocked leather satchel backpack with a cute pink plushie keychain. Japanese Lolita fashion brand, Atelier Boz, Triple Fortune and Nath are some of Sana’s fashion favorites. For more of her lolita streetwear looks, follow Sana on Instagram . sourceText: 20-year-old Japanese beauty school student Rikito wearing a clown inspired style on the street in Harajuku, Tokyo. Rikito has become well-known in the Harajuku street style scene this year as a result of his very original sense of style.
